description: 指定緊急避難場所一覧(小郡市)(共通フォーマット) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 小郡市. 小郡市の指定緊急避難場所一覧です。 久留米広域連携中枢都市圏で共通して公開しています。 令和6年5月から国の自治体標準データセットのフォーマットでも公開しています。. Coverage: 小郡市. The portal files it under the publisher 小郡市. Its tags are 位置情報, 共通フォーマット, 小郡市, 自治体標準オープンデータセット, 避難所. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
